target: doctor.sh forge section (gitlab) — HTTP 401 and 403 from GET /user are [FAIL]
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_gh auth_status 0 "Logged in"
unset FORGE FORGE_URL FORGE_REMOTE FORGE_TOKEN GITLAB_TOKEN
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj.git
export FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001
for c in 401 403; do
  fx_http "GET /api/v4/user" $c '{"message":"nope"}'; fx_reqs_clear
  fx_doctor
  fx_sec_has e${c}_fail '\[FAIL\]'
  echo "e${c}_reached=$(fx_reqs | grep -c '/api/v4/user auth=present')"
done
fx_done
